# repo-templates-gen

> Generate GitHub issue forms, the issue chooser config and a pull request template from one JSON config, with schema checks and byte-exact YAML Python package `trysac-repo-templates-gen`, import name `repo_templates_gen`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
